pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.body:
## Privacy Policy

We collect only the information needed to process your order (name, contact details, delivery address). We do not sell your data. Payments are processed securely by our payment partner; we never store card details.

For any privacy request, write to support@orvish.com.

## Return & Refund Policy

If your product arrives damaged, defective or incorrect, contact support@orvish.com within 7 days of delivery with photos. We will arrange a replacement or refund.
